raw.hs_code: 9302.00 / 9303.20 / 9303.30 (civilian firearms and parts; verify 10-digit HTS line)
raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and related parts. Exporters should re-verify ECCN classification and license requirements under the restored framework, confirm US HTS alignment for the 10-digit line, and re-screen for Section 301 tariff exposure and BIS Entity List / restricted party risk. Retain end-use and end-user documentation, and note that controls on military items (ITAR/USML) and sanctioned destinations remain unchanged.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽了民用枪支及相关零部件的许可与分类处理。出口商应在恢复后的框架下重新核实ECCN分类和许可要求，确认10位美国HTS编码对齐，并重新筛查301关税风险及BIS实体清单/受限方风险。应保留最终用途和最终用户文件，并注意军用物项（ITAR/USML）及受制裁目的地的管制保持不变。

checklist.desc: Re-classify civilian firearms, parts, and accessories under the rescinded-rule framework; confirm whether a BIS license is still required for the destination and end user.
Confirm items are not ITAR-controlled military articles; document the civilian vs. military determination before export.
Map the 10-digit HTS line, check Section 301 list exposure and additional duties, and document country of origin and value build-up.

checklist.task: BIS Entity List / restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Run restricted party and end-user screening; retain end-use and end-user statements for every shipment.
If relying on a license exception, document eligibility and retain records per EAR Part 762 retention requirements.
Verify importing-country firearms import permits and registration requirements before booking, as BIS rescission does not waive foreign market access rules.
